root_state.meaning: Unweighted sums of action-integrated BB root advantages on sampled cards, with exact initial jam targets. No reservoir replacement; not exact call/raise values.

exact_state.meaning: Sum of exact per-incoming-class counterfactual regrets; opponent reach included once. Not conditional per-visit means.
